text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka, having achieved a dazzling 
feat in the Kinko Sho, is praised by Air 
Groove as the new "ideal" for Umamusume.

Staking her pride as the "Empress" on 
surpassing her "ideal," she challenged 
Silence Suzuka to a showdown.

A true, earnest clash between Silence 
Suzuka and Air Groove is set to take place 
at the Takarazuka Kinen.
